settings.heading: What can a surface drug test detect?
settings.text: The OraScan Cassette V5 detects up to 6 drug groups from trace residue on surfaces. Check the product page for the current panel.

settings.heading: Is surface drug testing as accurate as saliva or urine testing?
settings.text: Surface testing detects the presence of residue, not impairment or recent ingestion. It is an environmental screening tool that works best alongside — not instead of — personal specimen testing where policy requires it.

settings.heading: Do I need an analyser for surface testing?
settings.text: The cassette can be read visually, but an analyser removes subjective line-reading and creates a digital record. For workplace evidence, an analyser is strongly recommended.

settings.heading: Where is surface testing most commonly used?
settings.text: Workplace investigations, site audits, locker and vehicle checks, and situations where personal specimen collection is not practical or not warranted.

settings.heading: Can the OraScan analyser also read saliva and urine cassettes?
settings.text: The original OraScan Drug Analyser reads saliva and surface cassettes. The OraScan 3000 reads saliva, urine and surface cassettes — choose the model that matches all your testing methods.
